quest.title: Heart of the Deep
quest.description: The fallen leaves float away, carrying with them stories of the past. Will the protagonists of the fairytale rekindle feelings from a distant past?
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Unknown Item #364507 x1, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like we're a few people short today...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Morning, friends. Xingqiu said he wants to take some time and focus on writing poems, so he'll join us later.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Noelle has other duties today, so she asked me to tell everyone not to wait up for her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, okay. Well, never mind... What about Callirhoe, though? She said she'd be here...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I got here really early, but I haven't seen her yet.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Are you talking about the girl with the blue hair? I saw her on the bridge near Dihua Marsh during my morning training.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: She looked a little upset, so I didn't want to disturb her...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Upset? Oh no... What should we do? Was it something we said last night? Paimon's worried...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We should go find her.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I agree! If she's run into some kind of trouble, I'd like to help her.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Huh? You're all going? Then I'm coming too!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Shall we start with the bridge? We're all here a little early, so there should be time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good idea. We'll be back in a jiffy!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Oh, so this is the place? We ran into her here yesterday, too!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: She looked like something was weighing on her mind then as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's also not far from where we were dropping those leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Leaves?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right! We were so busy matching couplets, we forgot to mention...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell everyone about your inspiration walk yesterday...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Huh, interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I wonder... Could Miss Callirhoe have been the one who wrote that poem on the leaf?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? What makes you say that?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Oh, sorry, uh... nothing — well, nothing concrete. Just a hunch, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: It's just... That poem on the leaf kinda gave me the same feeling as when I saw her yesterday. So much sadness...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, this is upstream from where we found the poem...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hey, look! Over there! Another leaf!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Wow, you're right! And this one has writing on it too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After that leaf!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh! Why does it have to float so quickly?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Can't you just fly over and grab it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... But Paimon can't swim, what if Paimon accidentally falls into the water...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: It stopped!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... we finally caught it...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Are the words still legible? Or have they been washed out?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the ink's intact! Let Paimon take a look at what it says...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? This is related to the poem we wrote in reply yesterday! She must've picked up one of our leaves!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Spring"... "young boy"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, it's looking a lot like Callirhoe was the one who wrote this.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: She seems to care a lot about that story, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, when Paimon first saw her, Paimon was wondering...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think... is it possible that... she's a—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's just focus on finding her first.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Based on the current and accounting for wind strength... everyone, please follow me.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: ...How are you holding up? Would you like some support, Miss Callirhoe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can also lean on Paimon if you need!

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...Thank you, all of you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew! Callirhoe, are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What's that!?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: It's a huge water droplet!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: ...This is exactly what I saw the other day!

response.text: ...Huh? Why are you all looking at me like that?
...Oh no! My body, is it...?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: That voice is definitely Callirhoe's...
Ah! How did this happen... Please wait a moment...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The water droplet turns back into Callirhoe's human form before everyone's eyes...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Oh no... Did I use up too much energy?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: How did you... What's going on here? Miss Callirhoe, are you some kind of adeptus?

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: No... I'm so sorry for deceiving you all for so long. Actually, I'm... an Oceanid, who flowed here from Fontaine long ago...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: What's an Oceanid?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Ah! The Grand Master has mentioned them before — the Oceanids were the familiars of the former Hydro Archon. They all fled Fontaine after the archon died, and settled across the world...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: That's correct... Though, to tell you the truth, I can't even completely recall how I found myself here...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: I have a vague impression of my ancestral home, but I can't recall clearly anything I saw on my journey...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: All I know is that by the time I arrived in Mondstadt, I had lost most of my power, and couldn't even sustain a physical form...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Eventually, I settled in a place called Springvale, where I slowly began to regain my power...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Springvale is a serene and beautiful place. The water that flows through there is clear and pure, just like the hearts of the people who dwell there.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: So you're the spring fairy of Springvale?

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Yes, Diona, and I remember you too, you know! When you were little, you often came to the spring at night to speak with me.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Really? You're not messing with me, are ya?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: (I... I always thought that was just a local legend...)

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Your favorite little pillow, the fish one... Its name is "Bubbles," is it not?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...Yep!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: (All those childhood memories... so they weren't just a dream!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... if this is true, then all those things written on the leaves...

choices.text: The moonlight flows like silken honey...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: I see... So you were the ones who found my leaf...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Well, you are correct... the spring fairy in "Heart of Clear Springs" is me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No wonder you were asking us so many questions about it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, the boy from the story...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: ...Is Finch.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: I always loved listening to people's dreams... And still do, to this day.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Whether they're beautiful, sad, or filled with emotions I couldn't understand at the time...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: One night, a little boy came to the spring. The tears that fell from his face were more fragile than a moonbeam, and purer than the morning dew...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: I like humans, and wanted to understand them better. I also wanted to make sense of the feelings contained in his tears that were then a mystery to me...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And so you became friends.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Yes. We often met under the stars, sharing our stories with one another.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Sometimes, we'd stay up all night and see who would hear the first bird chirping from the boughs, or the first cicada of summer...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, that sounds lovely.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: But... One day, just like the book says, I saw an emotion in Finch's eyes that I couldn't reciprocate...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: I felt out of my depth, in uncharted waters... But I knew all too well that we Lochfolk face a very different fate from that of humans. Whatever was happening, I didn't want it to lead to Finch writing a chapter of his life that he would later come to regret...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: So, I fled, and never appeared before him again...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Oh, Callirhoe...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: My strength returns very slowly, and even after decades... I can only sustain a physical form for a very short time...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: I once hoped that Finch would be able to move on, and meet me "when the stars in the night sky have all gone out."

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: But after seeing so many people's stories, and hearing about all their dreams, I have gradually come to understand Finch's heart...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: This feeling of wanting to respond to his feelings is surging relentlessly in my chest, and I can no longer restrain it.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: But I'm also scared. Scared that if I go and see him now, I'll bring nothing but disappointment... and even more pain, when it comes time to part...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: (It really is a difficult choice...)

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Please, go see him!

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I know Grandpa Finch, and he's a really kind person! When I was struggling to learn how to draw maps, he was always encouraging me... telling me not to give up, always keep trying, and get out there and have some adventures!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: He often tells me stories about his past, but I've never once seen a look of regret or sadness in his face!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: And even though Grandpa Finch loves adventures, he still stands there by the spring, every day, as if he's waiting for something.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I believe that he's serious about his feelings for you, Miss Callirhoe! He's never stopped hoping that he'll see you again one day!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: So if you want to see him too... then what are you waiting for!?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: ...Huh!? Ah! I—I... Sorry, I think I got a bit too excited, and... and I just thought... Well, it just sorta came out...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: I understand... That settles it. I've decided.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: I will go back and see Finch.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: ...You will? Amazing! That's great!

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: But... I'd like to ask all of you for some help...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure! Just say the word, we'll help you any way we can.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Would you come to Springvale with me, and help to bring Finch to my side?

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: I cannot maintain this form for much longer... And I'm worried others will see me how I was just before...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Leave it to me! I'm really close with Grandpa Finch.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Also... please keep Finch's and my secret... I wouldn't want Springvale's tranquil waters to become agitated on account of all this...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Your secret is safe with me.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: I won't tell anyone. That's a promise.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Great... I can't thank you all enough...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Aah...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's wrong? Are you gonna turn back into a water droplet?

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: No... I'm sorry, it's just that my mind's racing... As much as I want to talk to him again, I'm still worried that I won't have the words when the time comes...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: A poem...

choices.text: All the things you hide deep inside your heart...

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: Okay, good idea. I'll write him a poem.

response.speaker: Callirhoe
response.text: And it will be called... Heart of Clear Springs.

choices.text: Everything you never had the chance to say...
That was great! Didn't know you had it in you.
The boy by the spring grows old and frail...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: *gasp*

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: ...Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...It's nothing... I'm just scared that I won't be able to maintain this form much longer.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Okay, don't panic... Wait here, Callirhoe! I'll go fetch Grandpa Finch!

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...Take it slow, Diona.... Finch isn't a young man anymore, he's not as steady on his feet...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: I can still... hold on... a bit longer...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Okay! Stay strong! You can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Grandpa Finch!

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Is that Diona? You're back early today.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Today's your special day, Grandpa Finch! Can you come with me?

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Oh? Well, where are we going?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Over there, to the waterfall!

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Haha, did you catch a nice little fishie?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Ugh, just come with me already! This is extremely important!

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: But, I promised your father that I'd go to...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Grandpa Finch!

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Alright, alright... No need to get worked up, I'm right behind you...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: That's more like it. Now, come on, I'll help you.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: (Ohoho, Draff's daughter is just like him when she's on a mission...)

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Over here, over here! It's okay, Grandpa Finch, take your time.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Hmm? What's all this? What are all these people doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Even Mika's here? Haha, how's work been going lately?

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: And even some friends from abroad, if I'm not mistaken? ...You do know that today's not my birthday, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Greetings, Mr. Finch. My name is Chongyun. We all met at the poetry gala, and... Well, there's someone we'd like to introduce you to...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...Finch.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: ...! That voice... Callirhoe?

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...I didn't think you'd still remember.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: ...Oh, I remember, hahaha, I remember alright. How could I ever forget?

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Although, your appearance is different than I recall. Back then, you looked like you'd stepped right out of a fairytale...

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Oho, but I'm one to talk! Of course a fairy from a fairytale can change forms... In your eyes, I'm probably the one who's changed beyond all recognition...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: Haha... Oh, even after all these years, you still know just what to say to make me laugh.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: I thought you were only able to appear in the dead of night? ...There have been times when I've wondered whether it really was all a dream...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry I kept you waiting for so long, Finch.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: ...Oh, it can't have been that long... It's been but the blink of an eye, really.

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...Finch, would you like to hear a poem I wrote for you?

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: A poem? You write poetry now? Well of course! I'd be delighted to listen... I'll hang on every word that leaves your lips...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...In that case, let me read you a story about the spring fairy...

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Yes... This is how I remember you from when we first met...

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: All those years ago... It really has been a long old time, hasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...Finch, I...

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: It's okay, I understand. Your poem, it... it explains everything...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...Thank you, Finch. Please, take this.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: It's so beautiful...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: This is a droplet of water condensed from my own power.

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...Finch, I don't have a physical form like humans, and I can't stay by your side. I don't know how long it'll be before I can change back into human form again...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: But as long as this droplet remains with you, our hearts will always be connected... no matter the distance between us.

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: I will always be one with the spring. From this day onwards, if you call me, I will meet you in your dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The true Heart of Clear Springs...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaaah...! It's so romantic!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shhh...!

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you've really learned a lot, haven't you? And you don't even mind that the kids are watching...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...Does it bother you?

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: How could it possibly? This is the happiest moment of my life...

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: I just worry that once I go to sleep, I won't ever want to wake up again...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: Huh!? D—Don't say that...

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I'm only joking! Ah, it seems that you still have much to learn.

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: Is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: (Hehe, Grandpa Finch and Callirhoe look so happy! What a purrfect moment...)

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: Diona, thank you for fetching Finch for me. I've never forgotten you either.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I used to chat with you a lot... Wasn't it ever annoying?

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: Of course not! You are one of the truest friends I have in the entire world.

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: That's why I gave you your gift. So that a part of me could always be with you.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: (Wait... So is Diona's ability to mix delicious drinks from disgusting ingredients a blessing from this water spirit?)

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: (And if so... Is it also possible that my pure-yang spirit is a gift from some being?)

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...My physical form is about to disappear.

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: Finch...

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Yes?

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: ...I've never regretted meeting you, or deciding to talk to you that night. Not once, all these long years, not for a single moment.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: ...It probably goes without saying, but neither have I.

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: Although... it was different from in the stories... that fateful night, I never gave you that kiss...

dialogues.speaker: Callirhoe
dialogues.text: This gift that represents my promise and my love, I give it to you now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: At moments like this, it's only polite to close your eyes...

response.speaker: Old Finch
response.text: It's okay, everyone...

response.speaker: Old Finch
response.text: She's gone now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? But... Paimon didn't get a chance to say goodbye.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Grandpa Finch...

response.speaker: Old Finch
response.text: Don't worry now, she hasn't gone far...

response.speaker: Old Finch
response.text: Just like she said, she'll always be one with the spring... by our side, and in our dreams...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh? Hey, you're all back! And it looks like you're in much better spirits than before.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hu Tao's a step ahead. She's already talking about printing a poetry anthology.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: She said she "can't wait for everyone's final words, because I'm itching to pull the trigger." By which, I assume she meant she eagerly anticipates receiving everyone's freestyle poetry submissions to help her close the deal.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Where have you all been? I've been waiting here forever!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Perhaps they lacked sufficient inspiration, and wished to have an emergency communion with nature? And with any luck, I'll bet they heard some fine poetry along the way...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tone-Deaf Bard! Does this mean that right from the start, you—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Uh... Right from the start, you said you would treat us to a nice meal.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Huh? Did I?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think this is worth a meal.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #Haha, very well! Since {NICKNAME} agrees, then it looks like I can't escape this time.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Diona, dear Diona... Could I trouble you to fix us a couple of your delicious beverages?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Hmph! You wish! ...Alright, well normally I'd never agree, but... Since I happen to be in a good mood today...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Huh? So just what have you guys been up to all this time? Why does it feel like there are some unspoken words hanging in the air here that everyone is privy to but myself...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Really? Must be the breeze, you're reading way too much into it.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Y—Yeah! That's right, we're just, uh... taking a walk. Inspiration walk. Since it worked so well last time.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Oh, so even Mika's in on it...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Chongyun, how about you tell me what happened on the sly? I've just remembered that I heard about a haunted house recently that you'll definitely want to check out!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: I'm willing to bet that even your pure-yang spirit won't be able to scare off these demons!

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: I appreciate the gesture, but no thanks. Not this time.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: And I'm starting to think that... maybe this pure-yang spirit isn't such a bad thing after all...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Huh? What the... What's gotten into you!?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Okay, that confirms it! I call shenanigans, something big definitely went down here!

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Oh, child, let me stay here a little longer...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Listen...)

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: This should be far enough upstream. Let's split up and search the area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Calliiiiiiirhoe! Calliiiiiiirhoe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! She's surrounded by hilichurls! Let's go save her!
